meta.name: subagent-driven-development
meta.description: Use when executing implementation plans with independent tasks in the current session

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把大计划拆出的独立任务分派给子代理同时开工,快速推完实现
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一份拆好的实现计划,想让子代理分头把任务做完
copy.tagline_en: Dispatch independent tasks from a plan to subagents and get implementation done faster
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a broken-down implementation plan and want subagents to finish the tasks

howto.what: 按实现计划逐任务执行:每个任务派一个全新的子代理写代码,每完成一个就做一次审查(规范符合度+代码质量),全部做完再做一次整条分支的最终审查;进度记在 ledger 文件里。
howto.when: 当你有一份实现计划、各任务大体相互独立,并且选择用子代理执行(而不是内联执行)时接管。

say.text: 按这份实现计划逐任务执行,每个任务派一个新子代理
say.note: 会建 ledger 文件跟踪每个任务的进度

say.text: 继续执行下一个任务,不用问我
say.note: 中途不会停下来征求你的同意

say.text: 任务都做完了,跑一次整体分支审查
say.note: 派最终代码审查者看整条分支

howto.what_en: For each task in an implementation plan it dispatches a fresh implementer subagent, then reviews that task for spec compliance and code quality, and runs a final whole-branch review at the end. Progress is tracked in a ledger file.
howto.when_en: Use when you have an implementation plan whose tasks are mostly independent and you are running them via subagents in the current session rather than inline execution.

say_en.text: Execute this implementation plan task by task, one fresh subagent per task
say_en.note: creates a ledger file tracking progress

say_en.text: Keep going to the next task, don't ask me
All tasks are done — run the final whole-branch review
